title: 第23章 御兽峰的报复第24章 御兽峰弟子摊上大事了上
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
“无敌是多么~~多么寂寞......”
秦宇哼着歌，迈着欢快的步伐回到洞府。
先取出买好的绣花针，用蜡烛将其烧的通红后，只需在地上轻轻一压，一根绣花针便弯成了一个‘五号无倒刺’专业鱼钩。
从直到弯就是这么简单。
随后，秦宇取出提前准备的鱼线。
这种鱼线是修仙界一种蜘蛛类灵兽吐出的丝，平时用来修补衣服使用。
这种丝无色透明，韧性十足，据说就连万斤龙头罗非都拉不断，用来做鱼线简直完美。
最后在鱼线上绑上小木块做浮漂，找根竹子做鱼竿，装备就齐活了。
做好工具，秦宇欢快的跑到野河旁，开始了一天的垂钓。
“偷得浮生半日闲啊~”
秦宇躺在柔软的草坪上，晒着初秋柔和的阳光，看着水中的浮漂随着波浪上下起伏，无比惬意。
‘如果我现在就成为秦宇大帝，那人生就完美了！
想到这，秦宇取出随身携带的小本，将上面的《从铲粪开始的成仙路》划掉，改成《从钓鱼开始的成仙路》！
前面的名字虽然更有吸引力，但太过低俗，容易过不了审。
突然，浮漂猛地下沉。
“上鱼！”
秦宇用力一拉，一条两斤重的鱼便被钓了上来。
这条鱼通体呈金黄色，外形有些像鲫鱼。
“在充满灵气的地方生活，连鱼都长得不一样了，就是不知道味道怎么样。”
挂上蚯蚓，秦宇将鱼钩再次抛入水中。

“这两天有些懈怠了，明天要继续闭关了！”
秦宇在心中盘算。
‘我一晚上修炼百分之三的进度，修炼一整天就能增长百分之六到百分之七左右。
‘想要达到炼气二层，就需要修炼整整十六天。
秦宇有些头大。
受前世修仙小说的影响，秦宇一直以为修仙者动辄闭关几年、十几年。
但来到宗门后秦宇才知晓，但凡长时间闭关的修者都能进入一种深度修炼的状态，这种状态下十年如一日，是感受不到外界的变化。
但对于炼气、筑基期的修士而言，很难进入那种深度修炼的状态。
对于他们而言，修炼是很枯燥，上次闭关十天，最后几天就全靠意志力撑着。
这次一次性闭关半月，会不会走火入魔啊！
秦宇有些担心自己的精神问题，决定修炼十天后休息一天。
毕竟修仙也要讲究循序渐进，劳逸结合的。
秦宇心中吐槽：‘为什么我获得的系统不是那种，叮一下，直接获得五百年修为的系统。
content_en:
"How lonely it is to be invincible..."
Qin Yu hummed a song and returned to the cave with cheerful steps.
First, take out the embroidery needle you bought, burn it red with a candle, and then just press it gently on the ground, and the embroidery needle will bend into a "No. 5 barbless" professional fishhook.
It's that simple from straight to the bend.
Afterwards, Qin Yu took out the fishing line he had prepared in advance.
This kind of fishing line is the silk spun by a spider-like spirit beast in the world of immortality. It is usually used to repair clothes.
This kind of silk is colorless, transparent, and very tough. It is said that even a ten-thousand-pound dragon head Luofei can't stop pulling it, so it is perfect for making fishing lines.
Finally, tie a small piece of wood to the fishing line to make a float, find a piece of bamboo to make a fishing rod, and the equipment is ready.
After making the tools, Qin Yu happily ran to the wild river and started fishing for the day.
"It's a steal of half a day's leisure~"
Qin Yu lay on the soft lawn, basking in the soft sunshine of early autumn, watching the floats in the water rise and fall with the waves, which was extremely comfortable.
‘If I become Emperor Qin Yu now, then my life will be perfect!
Thinking of this, Qin Yu took out the small book he carried with him, crossed out "The road to becoming an immortal starts from shoveling manure" and changed it to "The road to becoming an immortal starts from fishing"!
Although the first name is more attractive, it is too vulgar and will easily fail the review.
Suddenly, the float suddenly sank.
"Get the fish!"
Qin Yu pulled hard and a fish weighing two kilograms was caught.
This fish is golden yellow in color and looks somewhat like a crucian carp.
"Living in a place full of spiritual energy, even the fish look different, but I don't know how they taste."
After hanging the earthworm, Qin Yu threw the fishhook into the water again.
"I have been slacking off a bit these past two days, and I will continue to retreat tomorrow!"
Qin Yu was calculating in his mind.
‘My progress of practicing three percent in one night will increase by about six to seven percent in a whole day’s practice.
‘If you want to reach the second level of Qi Refining, you need to practice for sixteen days.
Qin Yu has a big head.
Influenced by the novels about cultivating immortals in his previous life, Qin Yu always believed that immortal cultivators would often stay in seclusion for several years or more.
But after coming to the sect, Qin Yu learned that any cultivator who has been in seclusion for a long time can enter a state of deep cultivation. In this state for ten years, he cannot feel the changes in the outside world.
But for monks in the Qi refining and foundation building stages, it is difficult to enter that state of deep cultivation.
For them, cultivation is very boring. Last time they were in retreat for ten days, and the last few days were all supported by willpower.
Will I go crazy if I retreat for half a month at a time?
Qin Yu was a little worried about his mental problems and decided to take a day off after practicing for ten days.
After all, cultivating immortality also requires gradual progress and a combination of work and rest.
Qin Yu complained in his heart: 'Why is the system I obtained not the kind that, ding, can directly obtain five hundred years of cultivation?
